policy_digest.canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON with lexicographically sorted keys and no insignificant whitespace
policy_digest.envelope: All top-level fields and nested values except policy_digest.value.

presentation_digest.purpose: diagnostics, caching, provenance, and optional server policy
presentation_digest.constraint: A presentation mismatch cannot change authoritative state, commands, event timing, collision, projectile origins, or command acceptance.

may_define: gameplay rules, factions, objects, hordes, heroes, powers, upgrades, and AI
collision, navigation, authoritative terrain and water properties
deterministic map scripts, numeric constants, event timing, attachment origins, root motion, and random outcomes
must_not_define: native or managed executable plugin code in modding v1
client-local selection, camera, UI, audio, or render state
simulation.match_policy: The server and every playing client must resolve the identical simulation compatibility lockfile digest before joining.

may_define: meshes, textures, materials, shaders, non-authoritative animation curves, and non-authoritative effects
UI layouts, fonts, icons, portraits, localization, audio, and movies
quality tiers, LODs, accessibility presentation, and HD replacements
must_not_define: simulation fields, collision, navigation, or executable scripts
animation notifies or effect callbacks consumed by simulation
authoritative timing, root motion, attachment origins, ranges, radii, targeting, visibility, or random outcomes
presentation.ingest_rule: Strip or reject gameplay metadata, executable scripts, animation notifies, root motion, bone-derived launch data, and effect callbacks from presentation resources. Authoritative equivalents live in canonical simulation data.
presentation.match_policy: Clients may resolve different presentation digests when all referenced simulation identities remain presentable.

map.policy: Split every map field into simulation or presentation before hashing; unknown fields enter the simulation portion until owner-reviewed.
simulation_portion: players, teams, diplomacy, and team relations
authoritative object, lair, resource, capture-object, and neutral placement
waypoints, paths, trigger volumes, scripts, and scenario metadata
collision, navigation, buildability, terrain gameplay properties, water and naval rules
victory, defeat, spawn, economy, and deterministic random configuration
presentation_portion: terrain visuals and props proven to have no gameplay collision
lighting, sky, ambient audio, music, UI preview, textures, materials, and visual-only effects

manifest.version_policy: semantic version with immutable released contents
manifest.code_plugins_policy: must be an empty array in modding v1
manifest.unknown_field_policy: reject for simulation and mixed-map manifests; warn or reject by declared schema compatibility for presentation manifests

resolution.dependency_policy: Resolve the complete dependency graph before loading content; reject missing, incompatible, conflicting, or cyclic required dependencies.
resolution.load_order_policy: Produce and hash one deterministic total order from dependencies, explicit ordering, and normalized pack IDs; reject unresolved ties.
resolution.override_policy: Last permitted definition in resolved order wins at the smallest schema-defined resource boundary.
resolution.category_boundary: Reject a presentation pack that attempts to override or introduce any simulation field.
resolution.unknown_resource_policy: Treat unknown map/resource fields as simulation-affecting until explicitly classified.
resolution.diagnostics: Identify the source pack, resource identity, field, prior source, winning source, and violated policy.

server_policy.authoritative_inputs: simulation content and the simulation portion of mixed maps

resource_safety.path_rule: Normalize and contain every archive entry below its declared content root; reject traversal, absolute paths, links, and duplicate normalized destinations.
resource_safety.executable_rule: Reject native libraries, managed assemblies, Godot scripts, importer scripts, and executable resources in modding v1.
resource_safety.acquisition: No automatic acquisition or execution of community content.

before_publish: classify every resource and field by category
reject executable resources and enforce contained paths and expansion limits
resolve overrides and emit the canonical simulation compatibility lockfile
reject presentation-to-simulation writes and gameplay metadata
run deterministic simulation fixtures for simulation and mixed-map packs
verify referenced presentation identities or declared fallbacks
before_match: compare simulation protocol and schema revisions
report mismatched pack IDs and versions without transferring payloads
validation.required_negative_fixture: A presentation pack containing a simulation-consumed animation notify, root-motion value, projectile origin, effect callback, or script must be rejected.
validation.failure_policy: Fail closed for simulation ambiguity, unknown authoritative fields, invalid deterministic data, missing dependencies, executable content, unsafe paths, or private-containment risk.

dedicated_server.required_content: resolved simulation content and simulation portions of maps
dedicated_server.presentation_requirement: none unless explicitly used for validation or replay metadata
dedicated_server.headless_rule: Simulation packs cannot require Godot presentation resources to load or execute.
